[ASSISTANT_SAID] Combination skin can be challenging, but with the right products, a balanced and radiant complexion can be achieved.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended ingredients for fine lines and dullness include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Retinol: Stimulates collagen production, reduces fine lines, and improves skin texture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Peptides: Helps to plump and firm the skin, reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Antioxidants: Neutralize free radicals, which can cause dullness and damage to the skin.
